title: Gare d'Austerlitz
axis: The 103.5 m mapped roof edge aligns the station axis toward the surface rail fan. Named Paris Austerlitz and Métro 5 features distinguish the terminal from the Seine and Muséum approaches.
limits: The station shows the heritage envelope, restored hall and above-ground transport arrangement. Construction equipment, temporary diversions, underground levels and future retail changes are outside the modeled scope.
The 52-meter historic clear span follows SNCF documentation. Heights, façade recesses and the elevated Métro deck section are photo- and terrain-based reconstructions.
The fitted hall floor and station-end railway grades follow the standard viewer terrain approaches. The modeled elevated Métro deck covers the station crossing and its immediate ends.
